name: A Change is Gonna Come
description: "They won't listen," the Administrator sighs, showing conflicting reports. "The old systems are failing. I've compiled 'clean' data proving we need structural reforms, but the traditionalists are blocking everything. Help me present the evidence at the town meeting. Change is inevitable - let's make sure it doesn't come as a catastrophe."

name: A hard rain's a-gonna fall

name: All Along the Watchtower
description: The Iron Warrens are a sprawling Terran bunker-city abandoned after a reactor meltdown scare. Collapsed reactor halls echo with the hum of dying machinery, automated defense turrets run on corrupted IFF protocols, and a rogue command AI still believes the war never ended. name: Bad Moon Rising

I've mapped the patterns - need someone to recalibrate the emitters while I adjust the nutrient feeds. Bring prism shards; they focus the wavelengths perfectly. And watch for dust storms - they scatter everything."

name: Good Vibrations
description: The Barkeep slides a glass across the counter. "Taste that? Too much terrestrial influence. My rare alien spirits need proper aging, but the vibration dampeners on my brewing tanks failed. Probably sabotaged by boring water-lovers. Ttheire's a ring of fire growing around the mountain, and someone needs to put the beast down before the colony becomes its funeral pyre.

name: Sharp Dressed Man
description: The Quartermaker sniffs disdainfully at a mud-stained uniform. "We may be colonists, but we needn't look like savages. I've found pre-war fashion photos suggesting how to tailor proper attire. Need luxury scented oils for the finishing touch, and someone to gattheir materials from the clean zones. Primitive meat stains simply won't do."

name: Ship of Fools

name: Sittin' on the Dock of the Bay
description: "Built a proper dock with scrap wood," the Angler says proudly. "But my radio's picking up interference - sounds like... singing? Probably just old broadcasts, but my grandma's ancient Earth cookbooks mentioned 'siren songs.' Let's not end up like those sailors."

name: Space Oddity

name: Spirit in the Sky
description: The Red Basilica stands as a grim monument to fanaticism. Once a Terran research monastery, it's now occupied by a xenophobic splinter-sect that worships pretech relics as holy icons. rewards: Salvage:15|Credits:1200|Reliquary of Saint Kord's Last Breath:1

name: Sympathy for the Devil

name: The End

name: The End of the World
description: Settlers near the Woods report nightmares that come true and psychic echoes that drive people mad. Ttheir haunting entity seems to be coordinating nearby activity. Find it before its mindquake abilities destabilize the entire region.

name: The Sound of Silence
description: The Medic gestures to their sterile lab, untouched by the distant war sounds. "These quick-fix stims are causing more harm than good. name: Time is on My Side
description: "Fascinating!" the Archivist wtheirpers, studying a pulsating crystal. "Ttheir relic seems to manipulate temporal perception. But my equipment keeps failing. Rare flower pollen from the valley beyond the drone patrols could save them. I'd go myself, but... Terran surveillance watches the open areas. You look less suspicious. I'll trade you radio parts - I've collected plenty from their crashed drones."

name: Working in the Coal Mine
description: The Rustmines of Oldstead Ridge were abandoned when the pretech automation systems went haywire. Now, conveyor belts run endlessly on glitchy subroutines, mining drones have evolved into territorial predators, and a half-buried tunneling machine has been partially infested by the Maw. Need help redirecting a plasma stream through my modified still. Terran propaganda says it's impossible, but they also said my jukebox couldn't play century-old vinyl."

description: "They laugh at my mirrors," the Quartermaster says, polishing a gleaming surface. "But reflection is the first step toward civilization. Perhaps when everyone sees themselves clearly, they'll remember who they were before all ttheir."
